subject: Trial credit gateways & $/1M calibration — post-demo next steps
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@retaillytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-07T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Trial credit gateways & $/1M calibration — post-demo next steps

Hi Elena — great to meet today, thanks for the demo recap. Quick summary from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

What we heard (condensed):
- Primary use case: realtime personalization on product pages (session-level prompts, short chats).
- Expected pilot shape: ~350k tokens/day average, with short spike windows up to ~800k tokens/day during promos.
- Success signal: <1200ms p95 gen latency, relevance scores > 0.86 on your eval set, and clear unit-economics to take to procurement.

Cost/target economics you mentioned:
- Target economics bucket: roughly $1,100–$1,400 per 1M tokens (targeting $1,150 as a north-star for the pilot).
- Monthly budget band: conservative $8k–$15k/mo for the 30–45 day pilot window.

Proposed trial credit & guardrails (what we can do now):
1) Provide an upfront credit of $15,000 to cover pilot usage and burst windows, valid for 45 days from activation.
2) Credit will be applied to token usage on the hosted Redwood API only.
3) Auto-rate-limit at 1.2M tokens/day unless you opt-in to a temporary burst window (we'll raise limits manually when you confirm the spike window).
4) Security check: we need the completed security questionnaire and confirmation of the data retention requirement (we'll limit logs retention if you need).

What we need from you this week:
- Finalized expected token profile for 30 days (hourly or daily) so we can model SLO/cost and confirm the credit cap.
- Billing contact and procurement timeline (legal/PO cadence).
- Any specific compliance docs we should route to your security team.

I've attached a one-page pro-forma and a quick token estimate workbook for you to review (redwood-proforma-token-estimate.xlsx).

Next steps:
- Elena: send the token profile + procurement timeline (by Tue 11/9 if possible).
- Hannah/Monica: we'll hold the $15k credit offer pending Rishi's OK and receipt of the security questionnaire.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15m follow if it's faster.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-proforma-token-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet - pilot volumes & $/1M calculator)
From: Elena Morales <elena@retaillytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Retaillytics Legal <legal@retaillytics.com>
Date: 2027-11-08T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial credit gateways & $/1M calibration — post-demo next steps

Thanks Hannah — great summary and appreciate the clear guardrails. Quick answers and an updated estimate attached.

Real numbers for the pilot:
- Daily profile: 7am–10pm active window; avg 350k tokens/day; expected baseline 200k/day with two marketing-driven spikes up to 750–900k tokens/day (each spike ~2–4 hours).
- 30-day total estimate: ~10.5M tokens.
- Internal target: we'd like to keep unit cost under $1,200 / 1M tokens if possible. That gets us in-range for procurement approval.
- Budget: we can commit to a $12k budget for the pilot contingent on the credit covering unexpected spikes so we don’t blow the budget in week 1.

Procurement timeline: aiming to finalize PO by 11/30, but we need a short runway to validate production signals (hence the credit request).

I've attached an hourly token profile and a short note from Legal indicating standard terms are fine but they'd like confirmation on data retention and audit logs.

Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product Ops | Retaillytics
elena@retaillytics.com

Forwarding Elena's profile — TL;DR: 30-day pilot ~10.5M tokens, avg 350k/day with short spikes to ~900k/day. Retaillytics asks for runway/credits so spikes don't kill the trial.

Proposal from my side: approve a $15,000 pilot credit valid for 45 days, conditional on:
- Security questionnaire completed (they flagged audit logs & retention).
- Manual temporary burst windows handled by ops (we will not auto-expand beyond 1.2M tokens/day).
- Billing contact provided before credit activation.

Attachments: retaillytics-token-profile-20271108.csv (customer), redwood-proforma-token-estimate.xlsx (internal)

Can you confirm approval or flag any constraints? If approved I will send the formal credit memo and turn on the credit in our billing system.

— Hannah

Hannah — OK to approve with the following conditions. Thanks for the good context.

Approval: $15,000 one-time credit for the Retaillytics pilot, valid for 45 days from activation.
Conditions:
1) Security questionnaire completed and routed to our Security team (we will start with the redacted questionnaire but need full answers within 7 days of activation).
2) Credit applies only to hosted Redwood API usage for the account tied to deal RL-2027-042. No cross-account use.
3) Spike governance: ops will only enable temporary burst windows after SRE signoff; auto-limit remains 1.2M tokens/day.
4) Billing contact + PO or email approval from procurement required before the credit is activated.
5) If usage exceeds 20M tokens within the credit window, we will pause issuance and re-evaluate (customer will be notified).

Please issue the credit memo and send the activation checklist to the customer. Monica — loop in Billing to queue the credit in the next billing cycle.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

- Complete and return the security questionnaire by 2027-11-12.
- Provide billing contact and PO cadence by 2027-11-10.
- Accept the $15k credit on the terms above; we'll monitor daily usage and notify you before any planned marketing spikes.

We appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to getting the pilot up this week.

Elena
